cohort: The study included 1352 patients from 20 centres who were undergoing high-intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) ablation for uterine fibroids.
finding: Experienced physicians were positively correlated with higher Non-perfused volume ratio (NPVR), and an NPVR of ≥ 80% is recommended as a standard for HIFU treatment of uterine fibroids, as physicians in the no experience group completed the learning curve by the 16th procedure at this standard.
